priorityList: Apply Instant Poison and enter Stealth before combat.
If talented into Improved Adrenaline Rush, use Adrenaline Rush and Slice and Dice immediately before engaging.
Use Adrenaline Rush if it is not currently active.
Use Roll the Bones if no buffs are active or if you only have one buff.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have at least two Roll the Bones buffs active.
Spend Combo Points when at one less than maximum capacity.
Maintain Slice and Dice (refreshed automatically by Dispatch and Between the Eyes).
Use Between the Eyes on cooldown as your primary finisher.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher or as a builder if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Killing Spree as a finisher.
Use Dispatch as your secondary finisher filler.
Use Blade Rush if your energy is not near maximum.
Use Vanish or Shadowmeld to trigger Hidden Opportunity if you have no Audacity or Opportunity procs available.
Use Ambush whenever Hidden Opportunity or Audacity is active.
Use Pistol Shot when Opportunity is active to avoid overcapping stacks, then Sinister Strike as your basic filler.
